name: Jezero Crater
blurb: Perseverance's landing area: the crater floor, the western delta front and the delta top.

projection.name: Equirectangular, Mars 2000 sphere (IAU), latTs 0, lon0 0
projection.note: x = R*lon, y = R*lat (radians). North-south distances are true; east-west distances are stretched by 1/cos(lat), so the game multiplies projected x offsets by cos(lat0).

grid.convention: sample (i,j) of a level is centred at x0+(i+0.5)*mpp, y0-(j+0.5)*mpp; tile (tx,ty) holds samples tx*tile.. and ty*tile..
grid.world: game X = east true metres from the site centre = (x - x_centre) * cos_lat0; game Z = south metres = y_centre - y; game Y = height_m - height.ref

height.encoding: height_m = offset + (R*256 + G) * scale; B = provenance

levelling.method: HiRISE low-pass (48 m box on a 16 m grid) replaced by the CTX low-pass; HiRISE high-pass kept as it is (gain 1)

imagery.colour: single-band (greyscale) sensors; any colour on screen is a tint applied by the game

levels.what: CTX stereo DTM (20 m posts) bilinear to 16 m; HiRISE DTM block-averaged to 16 m where the HiRISE window covers
HiRISE stereo DTM (1 m posts) block-averaged to 4 m
CTX orthomosaic (6 m) cubic-resampled to 5 m
HiRISE orthomosaic (0.25 m) block-averaged to 2 m, levelled to CTX

pois.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
pois.source: NASA/JPL M20 waypoints, site 3 drive 0 (sol 13 localisation of the landing site)

pois.name: Three Forks sample depot
pois.note: Where Perseverance laid ten sample tubes on the crater floor, sols 653 to 690.
pois.source: NASA/JPL M20 waypoints, end-of-drive localisations sols 663 to 674

pois.name: Delta front, Hawksbill Gap
pois.note: The foot of the western delta scarp, where the rover first sampled delta rocks.
pois.source: NASA/JPL M20 waypoints, end-of-drive localisation sol 420

pois.name: Belva crater rim
pois.note: The rim of the 0.9 km Belva crater on the delta top, imaged on sol 772.
pois.source: NASA/JPL M20 waypoints, end-of-drive localisations sols 770 to 775

quality: CTX 6 m imagery and 20 m terrain everywhere; HiRISE 2 m imagery and 4 m terrain along the traverse
